Contract ManageBankCardCRUDService::createBankCard(cardid: Integer,cardstatus: CardStatus[NORMAL|SUSPEND|CANCEL],catalog: CardCatalog[CREDIT|DEPOSIT],password: Integer,balance: Real): Boolean {
	definition:
		bc: BankCard = BankCard.allInstance()->any(o|o.CardID = cardid)
	precondition:
		cardid.oclIsTypeOf(Integer) and
		cardstatus.oclIsTypeOf(CardStatus) and
		catalog.oclIsTypeOf(CardCatalog) and
		password.oclIsTypeOf(Integer) and
		balance.oclIsTypeOf(Real)
	postcondition:
		if bc.oclIsUndefined() = true 
		then let newCard: BankCard in
		newCard.oclIsNew() and
		BankCard.allInstance()->includes(newCard) and
		newCard.CardID = cardid and
		newCard.CardStatus = cardstatus and
		newCard.Catalog = catalog and
		newCard.Password = password and
		newCard.Balance = balance and
		result = true 
		else BankCard.allInstance()->includes(bc) and
		bc.CardID = cardid and
		result = true 
		endif 
}
